notes: Reviewed against contact.png and review.html on 2026-07-06. Preserve timing, animation, hitboxes, effects, sounds, and projectiles.

moves.label: Quick Fusion Jab
moves.description: Quick high jab with a long active check that keeps close pressure moving.
moves.reason: Standing left-hand poke at head and chest height with fast startup.

moves.label: Low Fusion Sweep
moves.description: Slow low sliding kick that reaches the shin line with weak left-side coverage.
moves.reason: Extended crouching slide clearly attacks the lower body.

moves.label: Fusion Body Blow
moves.description: Quick mid punch with a short active window for checking step-ins.
moves.reason: Compact right-hand body strike, not a signature special.

moves.label: Heavy Fusion Kick
moves.description: Slow mid kick with a sweeping leg arc and enough recovery to feel committed.
moves.reason: Standing kick swings across the torso line with right-side coverage.

moves.label: Fusion Cross Strike
moves.description: Steady mid two-hand strike with a brief active window after the step-in.
moves.reason: Short advancing upper-body strike sequence.

moves.label: Rising Fusion Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher that pops upward from a sliding kick sequence.
moves.reason: Sliding attack is authored as a launcher and visually rises out of the low extension.

moves.label: Vegito Sword Tornado
moves.description: Quick mid sword-spin tornado that hops forward as a juggle extender.
moves.reason: Airborne rotating slash with the blue Spirit Sword-style arc.

moves.label: Low Fusion Feint
moves.description: Slow low step-in kick with a moderate active window for clipping grounded movement.
moves.reason: Forward lean and low leg extension read as a grounded shin attack.

moves.label: Low Sword Tornado
moves.description: Slow low airborne tornado that flips through the legs and knocks down on hit.
moves.reason: Low entry into a flipping blue-arc spin with knockdown behavior.

moves.label: Spirit Sword Tornado
moves.description: Slow mid sword tornado with knockdown power after the airborne spin.
moves.reason: Clear airborne rotating sword arc that functions as a tornado ender.

moves.label: Crouch Fusion Flurry
moves.description: Fast mid crouch flurry with very long active time and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Begins from a crouched stance and chains into a close-range hand rush.

moves.label: Crouch Spirit Launcher
moves.description: Fast mid launcher that erupts with a blue sword pillar before recovery.
moves.reason: Vertical blue energy blade clearly supports the launcher role.

moves.label: Final Kamehameha Drive
moves.description: Fast special rush with very long active time that drives forward into a knockdown.
moves.reason: Signature fusion-special slot uses an extended aura rush and heavy finish.

moves.label: Overdrive Sword Tornado
moves.description: Quick mid overdrive tornado that hops into a blue sword spin for juggle extension.
moves.reason: Overdrive command reuses the airborne Spirit Sword tornado pattern.

moves.label: Sidestep Low Hop Kick
moves.description: Steady low hop kick with long active time after the sidestep entry.
moves.reason: Low sliding kick sequence starts after a lateral setup and leaves the ground.

moves.label: Sidestep Sword Tornado
moves.description: Quick mid sidestep tornado that jumps into a spinning sword arc.
moves.reason: Sidestep route clearly uses the airborne blue sword tornado.

moves.label: Rising Fusion Strike
moves.description: Quick mid while-standing strike with steady active time and clean recovery.
moves.reason: While-standing punch rises into a compact body-level hit.

moves.label: Rising Sword Tornado
moves.description: Steady mid while-standing tornado with a short active hit after the jump.
moves.reason: Rising route transitions into the airborne sword-spin animation.

moves.label: Ducking Low Hop Kick
moves.description: Steady low hop kick with long active time from a ducking approach.
moves.reason: Low command uses the sliding hop-kick pattern at shin height.

moves.label: Diagonal Fusion Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with a tiny active window and high commitment.
moves.reason: Forward-diagonal strike is authored as a launcher and visually lifts from a body blow.

moves.label: Diagonal Low Hop Kick
moves.description: Steady low hop kick with long active time from a forward diagonal entry.
moves.reason: Forward-diagonal route uses the same low sliding hop-kick animation.

moves.label: Fusion Rushdown
moves.description: Fast mid rush with very long active time and quick recovery on the finish.
moves.reason: Advancing close-range rush is a straightforward fusion pressure tool.

moves.label: Forward Fusion Strike
moves.description: Quick mid advancing strike with steady active time and compact recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command uses a direct body-level hand strike.

moves.label: Advancing Low Hop Kick
moves.description: Steady low hop kick with long active time after the forward step.
moves.reason: Forward route clearly attacks low with the sliding hop-kick animation.

moves.label: Fusion Low Hop Kick
moves.description: Steady low quarter-circle hop kick with long active time and left-side tracking.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle kick uses the repeated low sliding hop-kick animation.

moves.label: Final Sword Tornado
moves.description: Slow mid sword tornado with a brief hit window that knocks down after the jump.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle finisher is a committed airborne sword-spin knockdown.
